parameters.prompt: The exact upright bat warrior in the reference performs ONE ordinary screech attack in place. From the resting pose it pulls the head back and half-opens both wings, then thrusts the head forward toward screen left with the mouth wide open in a screech, wings spread, holds for a brief moment, then closes the mouth, folds the wings and calmly returns to the exact original standing pose and holds it. Both feet stay planted. Exactly two arms, two wings and two legs. Keep the same three-quarter left view, bat head, ears, fur, wings and clothing. No walking, flying, turning around, jumping, second attack, extra limbs, weapon, sound waves, rings. It stays at the same spot and size and does not move across the frame. Fixed camera, fixed size, pure uniform bright green #00FF00 background. The whole character stays inside the frame with clear margins at all times. Do not change any colours or tint. No motion blur, motion trails, afterimages, speed lines, glow, energy, liquid, spray, projectile, particles, dust, shadow or text.
